# DataMgmt Node

> Decentralized enterprise data management platform combining blockchain, P2P networking (Kademlia DHT), and end-to-end encryption for secure, compliant data sharing.

## Overview

DataMgmt Node enables organizations to share data without centralized servers. All operations are recorded on EVM-compatible blockchains (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum) for immutable audit trails.

## Key Stats

- Encryption: Fernet (AES-128-CBC) with PBKDF2 key derivation (480,000 iterations)
- P2P Protocol: Kademlia DHT supporting 10,000+ nodes with O(log n) lookups
- Supported Chains: Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, any EVM chain
- License: MIT (fully open source)

## Core Features

- Blockchain-backed compliance audit trails
- End-to-end encryption with key rotation
- Token payments (native + ERC-20) for data monetization
- Plugin architecture for extensibility
- Three APIs: Internal (8080), External (8081), Dashboard (8082)

## Primary Use Cases

- HIPAA-compliant healthcare data exchange
- SOX-compliant financial data sharing
- GDPR-compliant EU data transfers
- Supply chain document verification
- Enterprise data monetization
